published_implementation.historical_relation: The source invokes the installed Claude Code, OpenCode, and Pi CLIs directly while stripping operator-specific plugins, shared skills, global instructions, and other personal configuration identified during contamination audits. Exact historical CLI versions are not recovered by W1.

execution.environment: host-based execution without Docker in isolated per-trial workspaces adapted from Terminal-Bench task directories
execution.evaluator: each task's own hidden test suite, executed after the harness call
execution.reset_policy: fresh per-trial workspace copied from the selected task inputs; prior harness state is not inherited through the workspace
execution.isolation_policy: operator-specific Claude Code plugins, global instructions, custom agents, MCP configuration, and slash-command surface are stripped or disabled for the subprocess and restored afterward
